Stockton teen girl shot after bullet goes through wall 

by Bay City News Aug. 23, 2026, 11:27 a.m.Aug. 23, 2026, 11:27 a.m.

A Stockton teenager was shot when a firearm discharged inside a residence in the Seaport District on Friday.  
The 13-year-old girl was struck by a bullet after it went through a wall from another room, according to the Stockton Police Department.  
The shooting happened in the 600 block of Queensland Circle at about 7:45 p.m.  
The girl was taken to a hospital with injuries that were not life threatening, police said.  
Police did not make any arrests.
